newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar extends gains to finish stronger.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar extends gains to finish stronger.

text.p: White sugar futures extended earlier gains to close firmer on Thursday evening ahead of the March raws contract expiry at the close of business on Friday.
Most active May finished $2.00 higher at its peak of the day of $308.10 per tonne after earlier touching a low of $306.50.
August ended $1.60 firmer at $307.80, also its high.
The May/August spread accounted for a good deal of business, traders said.
Volume was 1,221 lots, with 781 lots in May.
In Paris, May was 50 cents higher at $307.50 and August 60 cents stronger at $306.50.
